page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5.16xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.g5 server family. It is built on the KVM hypervisor and powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor with an x86_64 architecture. The instance features 64 dedicated vCPUs operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz, paired with 256.0 GB of system memory. This configuration establishes a balanced 1:4 ratio of vCPUs to RAM, providing 4.0 GB of memory per core.

The instance does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external network-attached block storage. For network connectivity, the ecs.g5.16xlarge offers a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps, which supports stable data transfer rates for distributed systems. It does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given its balanced resource allocation, this instance is designed for workloads requiring a steady mix of compute and memory capacity. It is suitable for enterprise-level web serving, medium-to-large databases, containerized applications, and general-purpose business applications that do not require specialized hardware acceleration or local NVMe storage.
